relationships.evidence_quote: The collective evidence from this study suggests that SCF may attenuate uterine spasm by inhibiting the RhoA/ROCK signaling pathway, decreasing the levels of PGF2α, NO and Ca<sup>2+</sup>, and increasing the content of PGE2.

key_findings: SCF inhibited uterine smooth muscle tone and attenuated writhing in primary dysmenorrhea rats.
SCF likely acts via RhoA/ROCK inhibition and increased PGE2.
